purpose: Evidence for selected localized article experiments; selection is not publication status. Source frontmatter and the deployed revision determine whether a URL is retired.
record_key: Exact repository source path; retirementEvidence uses an RFC6901 JSON Pointer into records. All records inherit the global policy, windows, attribution and limitations below.

policy.owner: Nibomo editorial policy, not a Google requirement
policy.age_basis: UTC audit date minus the later of declared publication date and first Git source appearance date, following verified renames. Git availability is not a proven deployment date.
policy.attribution_required: Known source age, complete search identity and export coverage, and no unresolved engaged blog views that could belong to a candidate; unknown data is not zero.
policy.concrete_use_veto: Known backlinks, support obligations, seasonal or strategic uses veto selection. No concrete use veto is recorded for these 655 selected sources.
policy.selection_scope: Entire current localized blog corpus; all eligible URLs, with no deletion quota.
policy.partial_engagement_history: Observed healthy short engagement history is accepted with the actual bounds below; no 60-day absence-of-readers claim is made.

corpus_decisions.blocked_interpretation: The 153 excluded English/Japanese URLs are not individually proven unused or positive. Their unresolved locale-level use prevents selection; they remain outside records.

search.source: Google Search Console successfully exported WEB URL aggregates, including anonymized queries; verified domain and alias observations aggregated per localized article without multiplying overlapping property rows.
search.coverage_limit: Combined exports cover the verified canonical-domain periods. New-domain dates before Sep16 are unavailable, not observed zeros. Missing URL rows count as zero only within established export and identity coverage.
search.job_metadata_limit: Query job ID and processed-byte count were unavailable.

engagement.positive_refresh: All 655 selected canonical paths and every verified alias remain at zero assigned filtered engaged page views in the refreshed aggregate.
engagement.positive_veto_rule: Every assignable positive in early Sep22-23 history and current partial Oct20 is included, even outside the 26 complete attributable days.
engagement.qualification: A page view belongs to a filtered engaged visitor UTC day with a page view and at least two qualifying site facts across the whole website, before filtering article paths. No article-local interaction is required; visitor-days are not unique people.
engagement.identified_day: Resolved actor identity with occurred_at UTC date.
engagement.cookieless_day: Daily visitor hash with server_received_at UTC date; first complete cohort day Sep23. Actor and hash cohorts are not merged.
engagement.exclusions: Current shared actor, admin, test, manual, automation, sandbox, bot, suspicious burst and materialized scraper-fleet exclusions are retained for the respective cohorts.
engagement.materialized_exclusions: Both expected classifications were populated; scheduled refresh succeeded at 2026-10-20T13:50:23.568Z before the data query.
engagement.cookieless_exclusion_limit: Cookieless hashes have no actor, so actor-based admin/test/manual exclusions cannot reach them, matching the source contract.
engagement.url_attribution: Locale-stripped page_path is combined with ui_locale, normalized and joined through verified aliases. Missing or unknown locale/path is unassigned rather than English or zero.

instrumentation.limit: Old/new instrumentation overlapped; commit and observed event times do not prove deployment time or recover the older article paths.

engagement.negative_evidence_limit: The later visible-time plus interaction signal cannot reconstruct earlier single-page readers without a second fact. Zero observed qualified use is not proof of no readers and is not 60 days of no engagement. All selected records have complete candidate identity attribution under these bounds.

provenance.candidate_source_identity: All 655 candidate source blobs matched the evidence snapshot before edits; the immutable source_blob_sha in each record identifies the complete original source.
provenance.metric_contract_parity: All six relevant source-contract files match app main, deployed admin and the frozen runtime byte for byte.
provenance.source_date_provenance: Verified first-source dates and rename identities reused for unchanged source identities; current publication metadata re-read with no date changes.

rename_history.basis: same-commit historical source replacement; repository semantic slug alias / prior audit lineage
